prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a luminous light-neutral complexion with a soft peach-beige undertone, early 30s goddess, BBW bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — most massive full-figure BBW body ever at absolute maximum in every dimension, hips so wide beyond proportion dominating the entire frame, bust so enormous overwhelming gravity, waist deeply snatched despite impossible volume, sleek slicked-back deep burgundy hair — wearing a skin-tight micro bodycon mini dress of ultra-thin matte scarlet-red spandex with thin shoulder straps, the front zipper pulled down the center of her chest to her belly button, the two sides of the spandex fully covering her bust, both sides of the dress cut away in deep curved scoops from under her bust down to her hips, her whole waist sides and flanks bare, leaving only a narrow center panel of the spandex about three fingers wide down the middle of her stomach that joins the bust to the skirt, a plain ultra-high slit cut up the left side of the dress from the hem to her hip bone, the slit baring her whole left thigh and the side of her left hip, the hem ending just below her hip bones, a micro length hardly longer than a belt, her arms and legs bare, the spandex shrink-wrapped onto her body like a second skin, fully opaque, her face and hands bare. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a small mole near her collarbone and a light scatter of faint freckles across her shoulders and upper arms. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin spandex molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the narrow center panel and the clean curved edges of the scoops, the dress stretched taut over the curve of her hips and glutes, the open slit falling in a clean line, fine stretch lines and a soft matte sheen. Pose: full frontal wide stance, both fists pressing outer hips outward to absolute maximum — most extreme BBW bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, thigh-high platform stiletto boots made of glossy scarlet red leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, almond nails each longer than her middle finger, in scarlet red lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso, sculpted gold armbands high on both upper arms, and heavy gold rings on every finger. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Korean woman (East Asian Korean features: a slim V-line face with a small tapered chin and smooth forehead, large double-lidded eyes with soft fullness under them, a straight narrow nose bridge with a small rounded tip, softly full lips, gently straight eyebrows), an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: thick black eyeliner, extremely long dramatic false lashes top and bottom, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy peach-pink lips.

Background: a bright luxury hotel lobby with a polished pale marble floor, a standard-height entrance door, a curved staircase and a long reception counter, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
